definitions.short: Korach , the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
definitions.full: H7141. Qorach קֹ֫רַח 37 proper name, masculine Κορε (baldness ?); — 1 Edomite name: a. Gen 36:5 , 14 , 18 ; 1Chr 1:35 . b. Gen 36:16 (not ⅏ ; probably gloss from 36:18 Di Kau Ball and others; Holz hesitates). 2 Levite, rebel ag. Moses , Num 16:1 10 t. 16, 17, 26:9-10 , 27:3 ; in Geneal. Lists Exod 6:21 , 24 ; 1Chr 6:7 ; 6:22 ; ׳בֶּןקֿ 9:19 ; ׳בְּנֵיקֿ Num 26:11 ; especially ׳לִבְנֵיקֿ as company of Psalm-collectors (or singers), in titles: Psa 42:1 ; 44:1 ; 45:1 ; 46:1 ; 47:1 ; 48:1 ; 49:1 ; 84:1 ; 85:1 ; 87:1 ; 88:1 . 3 a 'son' of Hebron, i.e. Judahite clan 1Chr 2:43 Κορεε , etc.

occurrences.englishText: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
The sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,
Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’ ”
So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against Yahweh;
and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.
Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
“Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.
As the deer pants for the water brooks,
We have heard with our ears, God;
My heart overflows with a noble theme.
God is our refuge and strength,
Oh clap your hands, all you nations.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised,
Hear this, all you peoples.
How lovely are your dwellings,
Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land.
His foundation is in the holy mountains.
Yahweh, the God of my salvation,
